items.title: File Einspruch against cancellation of Kindergeld
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Beispielweser eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter states a separate posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) of Saturday 21.11.2026, so that date is the start of the delivery-fiction count. Kindergeld decisions of the Familienkasse follow the tax-office delivery rule (4th day after posting; if that day is a weekend/holiday it moves to the next working day). Counting from Sat 21.11.2026: +1=Sun 22.11, +2=Mon 23.11, +3=Tue 24.11, +4=Wed 25.11.2026 — a working day, so Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = Wed 25.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 AO-style counting (§187 Abs.1 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted) runs to the same day number one month later: 25.12.2026. That day is Christmas Day (nationwide holiday) and a Friday; the following day 26.12.2026 (2nd Christmas Day, also nationwide holiday) is a Saturday; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; the period therefore ends on the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026.
